notFound.description: This submission does not exist, or it does not belong to the organization you are tracking.

sessions.description: What the IFDD selected from your submission, with the confirmed slot and room.

empty.title: No activity scheduled yet

sessions.waitlisted: Nobody on the waiting list | 1 person on the waiting list | {count} people on the waiting list
sessions.reportMissing: The report for this activity has not been submitted yet.

reminders.description: Four reminders go out before the activity, and they are cumulative: every attendee receives all four. Times are given in {zone}.

offset.days: {count} day before | {count} day before | {count} days before
offset.hours: {count} hour before | {count} hour before | {count} hours before

history.description: Every change to the submission, field by field, with its author and date. Committee notes and recalculated values are excluded.

empty.title: No change recorded
